instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a sunlit modern office, the woman in the dark blue dress (R1) and the Black man in the white henley shirt (R4) stand by a conference table. Facing left in profile, the woman (R1) smiles as she reaches her hands forward. The Black man (R4), also in profile, leans in from the right to stack his hands on top of hers in a collaborative team gesture. Bright daylight illuminates the office background, casting soft shadows on the table cluttered with papers and cups.
